name: Advanced College Football Composite (ACFC) Top 25 Ranking Engine
description: v0.4.1: the RMS Game Control sub-component is now scaled by 0.925 before the quality-win bonus is added, so a top-10 win actually banks credit instead of being absorbed by the 1.0 ceiling (verified to change zero ranks, 0/26). The unverifiable 'Sideline Composite' benchmark is removed: stats.sidelineRank is renamed stats.compositeRank, every surface labels it an internal hand-maintained composite rather than a published poll, and the methodology modal's benchmark list no longer cites sources that could not be verified. audit/verify.js additionally asserts that the headroom factor is exposed to the UI rather than being an inline magic number, that a quality win measurably moves the component, and that no surface names an unverifiable poll.

versioningProtocol.minor: +0.1: Algorithmic weight tweaks, UI styling refinements, roster/schedule adjustments, heuristic updates
versioningProtocol.major: +1.0: New ranking data models, backend API integration, multi-season archives, or architectural changes

author: ACFC Analytics Group
